items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: Well, I know him too. I know Sid DeVean.

ctx.x: Well, I know him too. I know Sid DeVean. I know Johnny Babe. I know Johnny Babe who could play cornet. Sid DeVean could play clarinet and cornet. I know. That's what I tell you. It would be hard now for me to tell you.
Do you remember one band from uptown that's supposed to be real early? Buddy Bolden. Do you remember Buddy Bolden?
